ocrText: DEVILS BACKBONE GIN & TONIC READY TO DRINK REAL SPIRITS 7.59 ALCIVOL 12 FL OZ (355ML) GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects. (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.
